name: Basic Slider
description: Creates a simple image slider rendered through a configurable block using an attached JavaScript library.
project_description:
Basic Slider is used to create image sliders using drupal blocks. Multiple images can be uploaded in a single block.

 Implementation: 
 
 Go to Structure > Block layout > scroll to content region. 
 Click on place block button. 
 Under block check for 'Basic Slider Block'. 
 Click on place block button. 
 Upload your slider images. 
 Click on Save block. 
 
 Important notes: 
 
 Supports only single block for each page. 
 You can override css for the slider block for different resolutions. 
 Back to top
